simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דְּרָאוֹן (H1860) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דְּרָאוֹן (dᵉrâʼôwn) means an object of aversion First listed occurrence: Dan 12 2.

definitions.full: H1860. deraon דֵּרָאוֺן noun masculine aversion, abhorrence , absolute ׳ד Isa 66:24 object of abhorrence ; construct עולם דִּרְאוֺן everlasting abhorrence Dan 12:2 (on form compare Lag BN 200, 202 ). דרב (√ of following compare Arabic become accustomed, trained , train , compare Fl NHWB i. 444 ; also Ethiopic (quadriliteral) jaculando infigere , etc.; or, since דָּרְבָן Aramaic in form, & 1Sam 13:21 perhaps secondary, possibly regard as Aramaic loan-word & connect with Arabic be sharp, penetrating (GFM, note of Apr. 1892 )).
definitions.rootNote: or דֵּרָאוֹן ; from an unused root (meaning to repulse );
